messages:
maria.g: Quick sync — we need final owners for customer-facing follow-ups after last night's partial degradation. Who can own the 72h summary, the statuspage blurb, and the RCA access rules?
ryan.k: I can draft the statuspage line and a one-paragraph blurb. Will keep it non-technical.
samir.b: I'll draft the RCA-sharing rules and a concise redaction checklist.
beth: looping in @olivia.p for legal review on consent language and any NDAs.
olivia.p: Will review. We should require documented consent for any attachments that include traces or diagrams; I'll provide suggested wording by EOB.
maria.g: Required outputs: 1) 72-hour non-technical customer summary, 2) single-line statuspage update + one-sentence recurrence note, 3) 3-question FAQ for support, 4) explicit gate for deep RCA access (consent log/NDA).
ryan.k: Draft statuspage snippet (v1): "Partial disruption to hosted inference (May 12, 2026) — some customers experienced service delays after a recent configuration change. Service restored at 03:18 UTC. A customer summary will be published within 72 hours." Thoughts?
maria.g: Good. Add recurrence sentence: "We are investigating a recurring class of incidents and will share validated mitigations when available." Keep it high-level; avoid infra terms like hostnames or cache internals.
ryan.k: Updated and will avoid technical jargon.
samir.b: Proposed sharing rules (short):
- Redacted customer summary: publish to impacted customers within 72 hours.
- Detailed redacted timeline + mitigations: publish within 7 business days.
- Technical packet (diagrams/traces): enterprise-only, available on request with documented consent and NDA when needed.
Redaction checklist: remove PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, and sensitive security-control details.
olivia.p: Legal ok with tiers. Require the consent checkbox for any packet that includes sample traces or architecture diagrams; record consent in the ticket.
beth: Ill draft a consent checkbox and an optional bridge-call opt-in for enterprise customers; will share draft here.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-9001 "Publish 72h customer summary" — assignee: maria.g — due: 1800280000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-9002 "Statuspage update: recurrence sentence" — assignee: ryan.k — due: 1800100000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-9003 "RCA policy & redaction checklist" — assignee: samir.b — due: 1800150000
maria.g: Recap owners: 72h summary = maria.g; statuspage + recurrence = ryan.k; RCA policy + checklist = samir.b; consent template + legal = beth + olivia.p. Samir, please tag INFRA-772 in the policy doc so we track the recurring pattern internally.
samir.b: Will link INFRA-772 and add a recurring-incident tag. Note: this is the third cache-class tail event in six weeks; keep that detail internal only.
maria.g: Reminder to keep external wording identical across statuspage, support replies, and direct customer emails. I'll post the 72h draft here for quick review when ready. End of thread.
